message.Title: Generally Available: Enhanced Azure Site Recovery support for VMSS Flex

Body.Content:
Azure Site Recovery now offers an enhanced disaster recovery experience for virtual machines in Virtual Machine Scale Sets with flexible orchestration. The update improves target configuration and end-to-end recovery workflows, including failover, reprotection, and failback.

Learn more.
